subject.title: fix(channels): guard setup wizard text input trimming

question: Should maintainers require redacted live CLI proof for this bot replacement before merge, or accept source/CI evidence with an explicit proof override after the branch is refreshed?
rationale: The patch is a compatibility-sensitive setup and credential prompt change, the external proof gate is not applicable to a ClawSweeper bot branch, and current live mergeability is dirty, so automation cannot safely choose the proof threshold or behavior acceptance alone.

options.title: Refresh And Capture CLI Proof
options.body: Resolve the current-main conflict while preserving strict required-input behavior, then attach a redacted `openclaw onboard` or `openclaw channels add` run before merge.

options.title: Refresh And Override Proof
options.body: Resolve the conflict and land with an explicit maintainer proof override if source inspection, tests, and CI are sufficient for this bot replacement.

options.title: Pause Or Close After Replacement
options.body: Keep this paused or close it only if another conflict-free, stricter, and accepted PR becomes the canonical fix.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Capture CLI Proof
recommendation.body: Resolve the current-main conflict while preserving strict required-input behavior, then attach a redacted `openclaw onboard` or `openclaw channels add` run before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The setup wizard flow and helper history is concentrated in steipete-authored commits, and this choice affects the shared setup contract he introduced and refactored.
